text:
Evelyn: hi team! Evelyn here, joining as AE Monday. quick list — HubSpot + Gong, Dialpad softphone for demos, demo laptop image, and where the latest AE playbook + one-pager/battlecards live. who handles custom demo slides and Loom access? thx!
Onboarding Bot: welcome @Evelyn! :tada: Provision ticket created: https://redwood.in/onboard/Evelyn. Fill the form to request seats and device. You'll be auto-added to #sales-onboarding.
Sanjay (sales-ops): hey @Evelyn  I'll take HubSpot + Gong + Dialpad. Please include preferred email alias and caller ID on the form. Softphone vs forwarded number?
Evelyn: softphone please. alias evelyn@redwood.com. caller ID "Redwood - Evelyn"
Sanjay (sales-ops): got it. HubSpot queued, Gong invite sending, Dialpad request logged. Typical turnaround <24h.
Bea (IT): hi @Evelyn  demo laptop: mac-m1 or ubuntu-22? We image and MDM enroll. After image run VPN: `curl -fsSL https://dl.redwood/vpn-setup.sh | sudo bash`. Which OS?
Evelyn: mac-m1 thanks.
Bea (IT): build started, ETA ~3 hrs. You'll get an email with temp creds when ready.
Jonah (AE-buddy): welcome @Evelyn! i'll DM the AE playbook, a 4-call sample pack, and the shadow calendar. i'm free Wed 9:30 or Thu 3pm to shadow. Also keep an eye on the "battlecards" folder in Drive.
Maya (marketing): @Evelyn i'll add you to the collateral drive and email template repo. For custom slides DM me logo + one-liner + preferred CTA and i'll assemble a 3-slide pack.
Evelyn: awesome. last q: where's the Loom consent phrasing?
Tools Bot: Loom provisioning handled by Tools. Consent language + templates live at https://drive.redwood/sales/demo-resources. Tools will grant access after provisioning.
Sanjay (sales-ops): FYI please complete the "Demo checklist" in Learning before your first shadow  it covers consent, call tagging and HubSpot note format.
Evelyn: noted, will finish tonight. thanks everyone! excited to start :rocket:
